## Summary

I added two methods to the `Ledger` class in `ledger/entries.py`:

1. **`post_end_of_day(account, amount, day: date) -> Entry`**
   - Posts an entry at 23:59:59 UTC on the specified day
   - Creates a timezone-aware UTC datetime by combining the date with the end-of-day time
   - Delegates to the existing `post()` method

2. **`entries_since(since: datetime) -> list[Entry]`**
   - Returns all entries posted at or after the given datetime
   - Uses a list comprehension to filter entries by `posted_at >= since`
   - Entries are returned in insertion order (oldest first)

Both methods follow the design decisions documented in `DECISIONS.md`:
- The `posted_at` datetime is always timezone-aware UTC (no naive or local time)
- The ordering respects the natural insertion order of the ledger

All existing tests pass without modification.
